threshold_basis: Engineering defaults for smoke comparisons; not derived or clinical thresholds. Contact uses CHOIS single-window default 5 cm; retain upstream metrics separately.

canonical.derivatives: native sample period; only compare equivalent FPS/preprocessing

not_implemented_without_inputs.RULA: requires complete scoring inputs and validated scoring implementation
not_implemented_without_inputs.REBA: requires complete scoring inputs and validated scoring implementation
not_implemented_without_inputs.joint_load: requires mass, external forces and biomechanical model
not_implemented_without_inputs.muscle_effort: requires muscle model or measured EMG
not_implemented_without_inputs.FID: requires compatible official evaluator, real reference distribution and adequate sample count
not_implemented_without_inputs.R_precision: requires compatible official text-motion evaluator and retrieval protocol
not_implemented_without_inputs.diversity: requires compatible embeddings and adequate sample count
